name: qwen38_flash_next
notes: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 (125B + 51B PLE, 48 layers x 512 routed experts top-10 + 1 shared). enigma (RTX A4500, 60GB, NVMe 5.8GB/s) run of the #1621 protocol at ~4x the grid. seq_arms+link_mode because 185.5GB x 4 copies would overrun the volume. tensor_res zeroes the gate/up/down FAMILY per cell (FP8 weights; scales untouched -> fp8 0 * scale = 0.0 exactly). The shared expert is NOT zeroed by any candidate (regex is experts.<id> only); keep it that way. norm_topk_prob absent from config: treat as unknown, verify empirically by comparing mode-1-style zero-out vs a dropped-slot eval if the question ever matters. NOTE: published corpus is 18 lines (~10.6k tok); split 12 heat / 3 eval / 3 spare, holdout-by-line like #1621 (whose heat used all 18 + eval came from separate files — this split is the honest adaptation, disclose it if published).
